services.name: Skyline Trip: Sunset, Night & Day
services.desc: Meant for first-time kayakers, we begin at the boathouse with a hands-on lesson before heading on the wide-open Hudson River with guides. Ride stable kayaks and savor open skies and 360 panoramas. The Empire State and Hudson Yards are like peaks in a massive mountain range. This trip feels like an adventure away from the city in just 90 minutes total.. ☀️ Daytime: Dazzling and crisp panoramas. 🌅 Sunset: Serene golden hues abound. 🌃 After Dark: A huge spectacle of city lights. 🧘 Going Solo: You’re welcome alone. 🏙️ Office Reset: The ultimate unplug. 💘 Date Night: Better than a bar. 👯‍♀️ Friends: An outdoorsy escape. 📸 Visitors: Active NYC views. 💼 Small Teams: Groups up to 12.

services.name: Paddleboard Classes
services.desc: Unlike kayaking-where sitting low offers relative stability-paddleboarding places your center of gravity higher above the water. Your legs, hips, and core act as a shock absorber while power travels from your feet to your fingertips. Paddlers who self-teach on calm water or rely on their arms will tire out quickly in wind and waves. Why a 4-Week Series? Whether you’re a beginner or a vet looking for professional guidance, one-off classes aren’t sufficient in this sport. Over four weeks, you’ll train with the same small group of six paddlers under dedicated coaching. Graduate with genuine confidence you can take anywhere and lasting paddle partners. services.name: Surf City Social Trip
services.desc: Trade the gym for water. Paddle 10 miles round trip along Manhattan’s skyline to the Morris Canal. This is an outdoor workout on dynamic water. We pass Midtown, Little Island, The Village, and One World Trade Center. Then, we enjoy a social meal at the largest outdoor restaurant in NJ, chatting over guacamole and soaking up the seaside vibes before the return paddle. This is an advanced-level guided trip for sea kayakers and paddleboarders. To qualify, start with our class series or pass our screening; then, once you’ve completed 4 intermediate trips this season, you’re ready for this trip.
